content: XP mini dungeon with fixed kill gold (no drops, no materials)
goldNote: 2026-10-21: three times a hunting ground's gold pile (8~17). A player who spends the daily 30 minutes here instead of hunting lost the drop and material income; with this and the Lv40 enhance cost x1.35 both paths reach Lv40 with 82~88% of the clear kit (Tools/balance/theory_gold.py [--mini], BALANCE_MEASURE_2026-10-16.md 7). Ledger reason drop_claim, ref mini:<run>:<monster>.
scope: One character, shared across all three tiers
xpFormula: ceil(Progression.XpToNext(entryLevel) / 8000); catch-up: ceil(XpToNext(entryLevel) / 800) while every open main quest needs a higher level
xpFormulaNote: 2026-10-18: 240 -> 2000 -> catch-up 8000 / 800 with Lv16+ curve x2.2. Total play time to Lv40 must stay 42h or more. 2026-10-21 day model fixed (quest kills inside the 2-hour day): 46.0h without, 44.9h at 20 kills/min every day, 43.7h at 30 (Tools/balance/theory_progress.py --measured [--mini N]). modelXp values below are from the 240 design.

catchUp.rule: Next main quest waits on level: at least one open main quest (requirements and story flags met, not claimed) and every one needs minLevel or a level objective above the hero's level
catchUp.judged: Server, on every kill, with the current level (miniDungeonRules.mainQuestLevelGate); the client mirrors it for display (MiniDungeonCatalog.CatchUpGate)
catchUp.difference: Hunting grounds, dungeons and party hunting pay the same whatever the quest state; the mini dungeon is the place to fill the level the main quest waits on
catchUp.guide: 성장 추천 and 할 일 show it only while catching up, right after the main quest line

autoHunt: Starts on entry; manual movement/attack stops it; HUD restarts it
timer: Wall-clock while entered; explicit leave/death preserves unused time; no offline XP
online: Server-authorized timer, idempotent run/kill reports, bounded kill credits, dedicated XP ledger, no field loot or quest-kill credit

models.note: Model only; actual XP is paid for real kills and capped at Lv.40.
